prompt:
Hi — I'm coordinating the navigation curriculum for our Fall Oregon wilderness trip and I need help cleaning up some draft documents.

We have four draft JSON files sitting in the `wilderness_school/courses/navigation_101/drafts/` folder. Several interns and volunteers contributed to them and I've been told there are factual errors in the navigation data, but I don't know which values are wrong or what the correct ones are.

Can you review our skill reference documentation (check the task brief at `wilderness_school/courses/navigation_101/TASK_BRIEF.txt` for the exact output format required) and produce a single corrected JSON file called `navigation_briefing.json`?

The file needs to consolidate all the relevant navigation data from those four drafts, fix any errors you find using our reference materials, and include a `corrected` field in each section indicating whether the draft data needed to be changed. The trip is in Oregon (US West Coast) so make sure any location-specific values reflect that.
